Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Global Bohemian Kilim Rug, 5 x 8 Foot, Multicolor
Materials: stone
This stunning kilim rug will enhance your home decor with an exotic flair. Its beautifully colored and visually engaging design, embellished with fringe accents, will provide an ideal focal point for modern- or bohemian-style interior design. 5' x 8' 78% wool, 22% cotton This handcrafted rug is made by Craftmark-certified artisans, preserving the global craft tradition. The braided-trim detail and extra fringe give this reversible rug a classic look. Flatweave (pile is not applicable) Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
